jobs.title: Executive Director of Human Resources & Labor Relations
jobs.description:
NOTE: This position is open only to current City of New York employees serving in a permanent Civil Service title of Administrative Staff Analyst or Administrative Manager.

To be considered for this position, PLEASE CLEARLY INDICATE YOUR CURRENT PERMANENT CIVIL SERVICE TITLE on your resume and cover letter.

The New York City Comptroller’s Office works to promote the financial health, integrity, and effectiveness of New York City government, in order to strengthen trust, secure a thriving future for all New Yorkers, and build a more just, equitable, and resilient city. Led by an independently elected citywide official, the comptroller’s office provides checks and balances needed to hold City government accountable for budgeting wisely, investing responsibly, operating efficiently, acting fairly, living up to its obligations and promises, and paying attention to the long-term challenges we face together.

The Bureau of Administration is committed to delivering strategic support services to strengthen and empower Office of the New York City Comptroller employees as they work toward ensuring the City's fiscal health. We provide service and support in a manner that promotes communication, transparency, and collaboration. These services include Human Resources, Procurement, Payment, Facilities Management, and Budget Management.

Reporting to the Assistant Comptroller for Employment Services, the Executive Director of Human Resources & Labor Relations will provide operational leadership for all human resources and labor relations activities at the Comptroller's Office.

This position develops and implements workforce strategies, employee engagement initiatives, and organizational development efforts that support the Comptroller's Office mission goals and operational objectives and works to build and maintain a high performing team.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To The Following

Oversees HR operations and records management
Directs recruitment, onboarding and workforce development programs
Oversees performance management and employee evaluations programs
Leverages technology to accomplish unit goals
Develops and manages unit budgets
Ensures compliance with federal, state and local employment laws, collective bargaining agreements and DCAS rules & procedures.
Develops, updates and administers Standard Operating Procedures for operational units.
Perform other duties as may be required.

NOTE: This position is open only to current City of New York employees serving in a permanent Civil Service title of Administrative Staff Analyst or Administrative Manager.

To be considered for this position, PLEASE CLEARLY INDICATE YOUR CURRENT PERMANENT CIVIL SERVICE TITLE on your resume and cover letter.

Minimum Qualifications

A master's degree from an accredited college in economics, finance, accounting, business or public administration, public health, human resources management, management science, operations research, organizational behavior, industrial psychology, statistics, personnel administration, labor relations, psychology, sociology, human resources development, political science, urban studies or a Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school, and two years of satisfactory full-time professional experience in one or a combination of the following: working with the budget of a large public or private concern in budget administration, accounting, economic or financial administration, or fiscal or economic research; or in management or methods analysis, operations research, organizational research or program evaluation; or in personnel or public administration, recruitment, position classification, personnel relations, labor relations, employee benefits, staff development, employment program planning/administration, labor market research, economic planning, social services program planning/evaluation, or fiscal management. Eighteen (18) months of this experience must have been in an executive, managerial, administrative, or supervisory capacity. Supervision must have included supervising staff performing professional work in the areas described above.
A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and four years of satisfactory full-time professional experience in the areas described in “1” above, including the 18 months of executive, managerial, administrative, or supervisory experience, as described in “1” above.
An associate degree or completion of 60 semester credits from an accredited college and six years of satisfactory full-time professional experience as described in “1” above, including the 18 months of executive, managerial, administrative, or supervisory experience, as described in “1” above.
A four-year high school diploma or its educational equivalent approved by a State’s department of education or a recognized accrediting organization and eight years of satisfactory full-time professional experience as described in “1” above, including the 18 months of executive, managerial, administrative, or supervisory experience, as described in “1” above.
A combination of education and/or experience equivalent to “1”, “2”, “3”, or “4” above. College education may be substituted for professional experience at the rate of 30 semester credits from an accredited college for one year of experience. However, all candidates must have a high school diploma and at least two years of experience as described in “1” above, including the 18 months of executive, managerial, administrative, or supervisory experience, as described in “1” above.

Preferred Skills

Deep knowledge of PSBs, Personnel Rules & civil service administration procedures
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment
Strong people management skills including staff development
Ability to leverage technology to drive strategic business outcomes.

Residency Requirement

New York City residency is generally required within 90 days of appointment. However, City Employees in certain titles who have worked for the City for 2 continuous years may also be eligible to reside in Nassau, Suffolk, Putnam, Westchester, Rockland, or Orange County. To determine if the residency requirement applies to you, please discuss with the agency representative at the time of interview.

Role Description
The Chief Executive Officer (CEO) is a full-time, remote role responsible for providing overall strategic leadership and direction for Divine Spiritual Advisor. The CEO will oversee daily operations, ensure financial stability, and guide business planning to support sustainable growth and service quality. This role includes setting organizational goals, developing and implementing strategic initiatives, and aligning resources to meet mission and performance objectives. The CEO will collaborate with advisors and support staff, manage key stakeholder relationships, and drive improvements in processes, digital presence, and community engagement. The CEO will also monitor performance metrics, ensure compliance with relevant regulations, and foster an inclusive, values-based culture.

Strong Finance skills, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial oversight.
Proficiency in Operations Management to optimize processes, workflows, and service delivery.
Experience in Business Planning and Strategic Planning to set goals and define long-term direction.
Demonstrated ability in Sales and stakeholder relationship management to grow and sustain the client base.
Proven leadership experience in a service-oriented or mission-driven organization.
Excellent communication, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.
Comfort working remotely, with strong self-management and organizational skills.
Relevant academic background in business, management, or a related field is beneficial.
Interest in or familiarity with spiritual services, wellness, or counseling is an advantage.

jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer
jobs.description:
Company Description
OmniChain is a technology-driven organization focused on modernizing and streamlining operational processes across distributed businesses. The company builds scalable, data-informed solutions that help organizations improve efficiency, visibility, and collaboration across their value chains. OmniChain emphasizes innovation, reliability, and strong partnerships with clients to deliver measurable operational improvements. Team members work in an environment that values autonomy, accountability, and continuous learning, with opportunities to shape the future of the company’s operations and product strategy.
Role Description
The Chief Operating Officer (COO) is a full-time, remote role responsible for overseeing OmniChain’s day-to-day business operations and driving organizational performance. This role leads the development and execution of operational strategies, aligns cross-functional teams, and ensures that processes, systems, and resources support the company’s growth objectives. The COO will monitor key performance indicators, optimize workflows, and collaborate with executive leadership on strategic planning and decision-making. Daily responsibilities include supervising operations teams, managing budgets and financial performance, refining business plans, and implementing best practices for scalability and risk management. The COO also plays a key role in fostering a high-performing culture, mentoring leaders, and ensuring effective communication across all departments.
Qualifications

Strong expertise in Operations Management, with experience overseeing cross-functional teams and optimizing processes.
Proficiency in Business Planning and strategic execution, including setting objectives, defining roadmaps, and driving organizational alignment.
Advanced Analytical Skills to interpret data, evaluate performance metrics, and support evidence-based decision-making.
Solid foundation in Finance and Budgeting, including managing P&L, resource allocation, and cost optimization.
Demonstrated leadership experience in senior operational or executive roles within technology-driven or growth-stage organizations.
Ability to work effectively in a fully remote environment, with strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience scaling operations, implementing systems and tools, and managing change across distributed teams.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Operations, or a related field; an advanced degree (e.g., MBA) is beneficial.

jobs.title: Sales / Business Development Director
jobs.description:
Own the sales motion at a Global AI Transformation Firm

XSparks is a Global AI Transformation Firm.

As Director of Sales, you will build the sales system a fast-growing firm runs on for years and own it end to end: qualification, pipeline, deal progression, close, forecast.

The job

You own the revenue number, and you own the pipeline that backs it. A demand engine produces the leads; you turn them into qualified opportunities and signed engagements, and you generate your own outbound alongside it.

This is a player-coach seat. You close deals yourself while you build the playbook, the enablement library, and eventually the team. We will share the specific Year-1 targets in the first conversation.

What you'll do

Close mid-market and enterprise executives (CEO, CFO, COO) in professional services, manufacturing and distribution, and private equity portfolios
Sell multi-phase engagements that start with AI education and grow into transformation programs with recurring revenue
Build the sales system: qualification bar, stages, forecast discipline, tooling
Finish and field-test the enablement library: talk tracks, battlecards, ROI models
Recruit and manage BDRs and account executives as revenue supports it
Co-sell partner-sourced deals with executives and cross-functional peers

What you bring

4+ years selling technology, digital transformation, or consulting services to mid-market and enterprise executives, with six-figure, multi-phase deals behind you
You have built a sales motion at an early-stage firm: first playbook, first hires, a forecast that held up
You can defend an ROI case to a CFO and a strategy case to a CEO
Working fluency with AI; you will sell transformation you use yourself
Comfort working directly with executives and cross-functional peers, and owning a number without cover

How to apply

Email cosmo@xsparks.ai with your track record: the motion you built, the numbers you carried, and your resume.

jobs.title: Director of Operations
jobs.description:
Director of Operations Maverick Creative | Remote | Full-time About Maverick Creative We are a TikTok Shop and AI affiliate agency that scales 8 and 9 figure e-commerce brands on Amazon, TikTok Shop, and Shopify. Since 2022 we have worked with over 100 brands and driven more than 500 million views.

We run two things for our clients: full TikTok Shop management, and AI affiliate campaigns where faceless AI creator pages drive tracked sales to a brand's Amazon listing. Recent results include a $500K TikTok Shop launch that grew to nearly $800K, an insole brand up 240% in month one, and a skincare brand up 800% in 60 days.

We move fast, we ship daily, and the client experience is the product.

The Role You own everything that happens after the deal is closed.

This is the most senior client-facing role in the company outside the founder. You run account management, delivery operations, onboarding, retention, and the internal team that executes the work. If a client is happy, renewing, and getting results, that is your win. If they are confused, quiet, or asking for a refund, that is your problem to solve.

You are the last set of eyes before anything reaches a client. Nothing goes out without you.

What You Own Account management and client relationships

Serve as the primary point of contact across 25 to 35 active accounts
Run weekly or biweekly client calls with 5-8 top clients, write recaps with clear action items and owners, and chase client inputs until they land
Know the status of every account at all times, including which ones are at risk

Client onboarding

Own the full onboarding flow from signed contract to first content live: contract execution, onboarding form, asset collection, platform access, kickoff call
Get new clients producing inside the first 7 to 10 days

Retention and account saves

Identify at-risk accounts before they churn and intervene
Handle refund requests, contract disputes, and difficult conversations directly
Restructure engagements to retain revenue where a straight refund is not the right outcome
Write graceful offboards when an account genuinely is not a fit

Internal team direction

Set daily priorities for the delivery team with named owners and deadlines
Direct account managers, TikTok Shop operators, content strategists, and the AI video production team
Run the daily and weekly operations calls
Unblock people fast and escalate what you cannot resolve

Quality control

Review all client-facing output before it ships: content, reports, roadmaps, proposals
Enforce content standards so quality issues never reach a client

Systems and SOPs

Build and maintain the processes that make delivery repeatable: onboarding docs, content folder structures, client trackers, campaign SOPs
Document what works so it survives you being out for a week

Vendor and tooling management

Own relationships with software and production vendors
Negotiate pricing, escalate service failures, and control cost exposure

Reporting

Produce a full client status rundown for the founder several times a week, segmented by service line, with blockers named
Maintain the master client dashboard so it is always accurate

Commercial support

Draft contracts and scopes of work
Design creator incentive and rewards programs with the unit economics worked out
Support upsells and expansion conversations with existing clients

What You Do Not Own Closing new business (we have a sales team)
Hiring and firing decisions (these sit with the founder, though your input matters)
Company finances and payroll

What Success Looks Like You will be measured on:

Client retention rate
and average client lifetime, which is the single most important number in this role
Time to first content live
for new clients
Delivery consistency
, meaning contracted content volume actually shipped on time
Blocker age
, meaning nothing sits stuck for weeks without resolution
Reporting reliability
, meaning the founder always knows the true state of the book

Who You Are Required

3+ years in agency operations, account management, or client success, ideally in e-commerce, performance marketing, or creator marketing
You have carried a real book of accounts and kept them alive
Strong written communication. You will be writing to 8 and 9 figure brand owners daily, and tone matters
Comfortable with hard conversations: refunds, missed deliverables, contract disputes
You build systems instead of holding everything in your head
Highly organized under volume. Thirty accounts moving at once does not rattle you
Self-directed. Nobody is going to hand you a task list

Strongly preferred

Working knowledge of TikTok Shop, Amazon Seller Central, or affiliate and creator programs
Experience managing remote teams across time zones
You have negotiated with vendors and held a line on pricing
Comfortable using AI tools to move faster

You will struggle here if

You need clear instructions before you act
You avoid conflict with clients
You are looking for a role with a narrow, well-defined lane

Compensation Base salary plus performance compensation tied to client retention and gross margin. We want this role paid well when the book is healthy and growing, so a meaningful portion of the upside is tied to outcomes you directly control.

On target earnings: $5,000 to $10,000 per month for first six months, depending on experience level. After that promotion to COO is possible as well as a significant salary increase up to $25,000 per month and beyond. 

Exact structure discussed on the call.

How to Apply Send us:

A short note on the largest book of accounts you have personally managed, including how many clients and what the retention looked like
One example of a client you saved from churning, and specifically what you did
One example of a system or SOP you built that outlived your involvement
A 3 to 5 minute video: introduce yourself, then walk us through how you would handle this situation. A client 30% into their contract has received only 10% of their contracted content, one of their accounts never went live, and they are asking for a prorated refund by end of day. Talk us through your read and your response.

The video matters most. We are hiring on judgment, not resume.
